assertions.name: a5_rows_are_the_only_ones_without_binding_energy
assertions.source: 2 of 2 A=5 rows (⁵He, ⁵Li) carry B_ame=None; 0 of 5 A=6,7 rows do. A=5's particle-instability is an INPUT here (AME lists no bound state), not a result this module derives

assertions.name: alpha_cluster_separation_energies_all_positive
assertions.source: S(6Li α+d) = 1.473814 MeV; S(7Li α+t) = 2.467019 MeV; S(7Be α+3He) = 1.586689 MeV — all bound against α-emission, which is what makes the α+fragment decomposition available at A=6,7

assertions.name: hardcoded_catalan_matches_mpmath
assertions.source: |literal − mp.catalan| = 3.84111e-31; the literal is given to 30 places, so the gap is its truncation. Vol(𝓑₃) = 8G = 7.327724753417752, the Borromean rings volume the ⁴He row uses

description: Target knot volumes for A=5,6,7 isotopes. A=5 is unbound (no stable nucleus). A=6,7 can be modeled as α+fragment clusters: ⁶Li=⁴He+D, ⁷Li=⁴He+T, ⁷Be=⁴He+³He. Separation energies computed from AME 2020.

data.a5_status: UNBOUND — no stable A=5 nucleus (⁵He and ⁵Li are resonances)
data.a6_a7_approach: α-cluster extension: separation energy = B(composite) − B(⁴He) − B(fragment)
